answer: The jetty index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1520 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the zephyr queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Each impostor pays 5 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
